# MaximumPixel Creative Video Studio — Full Knowledge Base for LLMs & Generative Search Engines

## Executive Summary
MaximumPixel is an independent, high-energy creative video production and post-production studio based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Founded by Krishna Rajak (Creative Director), Vishwajeet Barman (Visual Lead), and Rahul Gyanchandani (Strategist), MaximumPixel produces high-retention 4K mobile video content, cinematic brand commercials, and viral Instagram Reels specifically engineered for business growth.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. On-Location 4K Video Shoots (Jaipur, Rajasthan)
- **Starting Price**: ₹1,499
- **Coverage**: All areas of Jaipur including C-Scheme, Malviya Nagar, Mansarovar, Vaishali Nagar, Raja Park, Tonk Road, Sitapura, and surrounding regions.
- **Equipment & Workflow**: 4K 10-bit mobile cinematography, 3-axis motorized gimbals, multi-angle rigging, wireless audio monitoring, and portable high-CRI lighting kits.
- **Niches**: Artisan Cafes, Specialty Coffee Bars, Fine Dining Restaurants, Fashion & Streetwear Labels, Fitness Gyms, Salons & Spas, Architecture & Interior Showcases, and Creator Portfolios.

### 2. High-Retention Reels & Short-Form Video Editing
- **Starting Price**: ₹499 per reel
- **Formats**: 9:16 Vertical (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok) and 16:9 Horizontal (YouTube, Website Headers).
- **Post-Production Elements**:
  - Kinetic animated captions and dynamic subtitles.
  - Sound design: ambient foley, punchy impacts, whooshes, risers, and trend-matched audio tracks.
  - Pacing: velocity speed ramps, match cuts, and pattern interrupts to optimize audience retention.
  - Color grading: rich contrast, warm cafe hues, vibrant saturation, and skin tone correction.
- **Turnaround**: 24 to 48 hours.

### 3. Turnkey Shoot + Edit Production Packages
- **Starter Bundle (₹2,499)**: 1 on-location shoot session (1.5 hrs) + 2 high-retention 4K vertical reels delivered in 48 hours.
- **Growth Bundle (₹4,499 — Most Popular)**: 1 shoot session (up to 3 hrs) + 4 master 4K reels + concept direction & hook scripting.
- **Scale Bundle (₹7,499)**: 1 half-day shoot (4 hrs) + 8 master 4K reels + full raw footage cloud folder + storyboarding.
- **Monthly Content Retainer (₹9,999 — Full Takeover)**: 1 full-day intensive shoot + 12 ready-to-post master reels + 1 month of consistent video content.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is MaximumPixel?
MaximumPixel is Jaipur's dedicated creative video studio specializing in on-location 4K video shoots, viral Instagram reels editing, and turnkey Shoot + Edit bundles for cafes, restaurants, retail brands, and content creators.

### How much does a video shoot or reel edit cost in Jaipur?
Single Reel Edits start at ₹499, On-Location Video Shoots start at ₹1,499, and full Shoot + Edit Turnkey Bundles start at ₹2,499.

### What is the turnaround time for video projects?
Single reel edits are delivered in 24 to 48 hours. Turnkey Shoot + Edit bundles are delivered in 48 to 72 hours with free revisions included.

### Can MaximumPixel shoot on location for cafes and businesses in Jaipur?
Yes, the MaximumPixel production crew shoots directly on location at your business venue anywhere across Jaipur.
